scientific_question: Does useful intervention value remain learnable from factual experience when executed final rewards are noisy (and cannot identify hidden theta in a single episode), under identical realized random probe logs for all learner families?

source.latent_theta: Bernoulli fair sign +/-1, never part of fit API or model input
source.probe_physics: only executed probe yields theta*visible probe_gain + visible probe_sigma*independent Normal(0,1)
source.final_reward: actual_observed_net_reward = theta * actually_chosen_final_action + independent reward_sigma*Normal(0,1) - actual_probe*visible_cost
source.logging: one actual probe Bernoulli(0.5), one final signed action Bernoulli fair, same log records across all fits, unexecuted diagnostic exactly masked 0, no alternative reward
source.all_generated_sources_fresh: 840xxx previously unused, no retuning on 830xxx consumed sources
source.evaluation: paired common stochastic world tapes, no train/validation/ood mixture

trained_methods.moment_candidate: method-of-moments cross covariance between real reward-derived noisy z=(reward+cost*actual_probe)/actual_final_action and normalized cue/probe; learn gain scale, residual variance, empirical prior; Gaussian value-of-information with fitted params, select physical probe only when expected decision gain > visible cost
trained_methods.moment_shuffled_negative: deterministically permute observed net reward among FIT episodes before fitting (preserve all cue/action/probe/noise/measurement distributions, break episode reward-credit) and report any diagnostics and gain; fit must use valid original logging schema
trained_methods.neural_MLP: factual supervised noisy return proxy z on same logged cues and actually executed probe measurements; 6->hidden->cue estimate and 8->hidden->post estimate; evaluated under identical moment-selected physical probe actions, not trained as an independent probe decision policy
trained_methods.neural_GRU: factual supervised noisy return proxy z on same log; 6 input cue then second-stage actual diagnostic tuple through GRUCell; equal source and parameter count within 10%, evaluated under same moment-selected probe actions
trained_methods.analytic_Bayes: known true Gaussian cue/probe law and current visible gain/sigma/cost, privileged strong ceiling; final reward noise cancels in expected action decision but remains in realized payoff
trained_methods.learned_never: same learned factual-moment model but no physical probes
trained_methods.learned_always: same learned model with all physical probes and full costs
trained_methods.P53_exact_reward_label_method: negative: original exact theta reconstruction fit must reject noisy rewards as invalid, not silently treat them as signs

training.neural_loss: MSE of both pre-probe and post-probe predicted theta proxy z from ACTUALLY OBSERVED noisy final rewards; z never available before final actual action
training.convergence: last two neural val MSE checkpoints relative change <=2% or mark competence UNVERIFIED
training.model_fitting: moment candidate uses full 49,152 logged factual samples, MLP/GRU 600*128 minibatch draws with replacement from same log, report sampling exposure difference
training.whole_process_cost: report training wall and inference wall, not claim equal FLOPs or greater sample efficiency

primary_ood_a_and_b_all_required: moment candidate realized mean net reward >= learned-never +.02
moment candidate within .025 realized mean net reward of model-aware Bayesian reference
0.05 <= moment candidate actually executed probe fraction <=0.95
paired bootstrap lower 95% CI on candidate minus learned-never reward >0, 1000 resamples fixed seed 840901+cohort seed
low-cost vs high-cost probing frequency among weak cue and strong diagnostic gains >=0.15 with both group sizes>=30
sham_controls: zero physical probes on uninformative diagnostic exactly, under positive cost
original P53 exact-reward-label fitter refuses the noisy observed-reward log
moment_shuffled_credit materially weaker than candidate by at least 0.025 net reward in each OOD
criteria.neural_controls: report per-seed MLP and GRU exploitation reward under identical actually executed candidate diagnostic actions; neither is end-to-end independent probing controller; do NOT claim native architecture superiority
criteria.cold: fitted moment JSON roundtrip produces byte-identical deterministic actions and realized rewards; neural torch state restore exact for pre/post predictions
criteria.science: authored synthetic dev positive cannot satisfy SCIENTIFIC_PASS; external, disjoint physical source/fully trained controls/cold-retention/total-compute needed
